cases.utterance: what is the total revenue from all orders?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price_at_order) AS total_revenue FROM orders

cases.utterance: what is the average order value?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT AVG(quantity * unit_price_at_order) AS avg_order_value FROM orders

cases.utterance: how many orders has each customer placed?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY order_count DESC

cases.utterance: what is the total revenue broken down by product category?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(o.quantity * o.unit_price_at_order) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

cases.utterance: which products have fewer than 20 units in stock?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT product_name, stock_units FROM products WHERE stock_units < 20 ORDER BY stock_units

cases.utterance: what is the average unit price per product category?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT category, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_unit_price FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

cases.utterance: how many customers are in each loyalty tier?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT loyalty_tier, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY loyalty_tier ORDER BY customer_count DESC

cases.utterance: which acquisition channels brought the most customers?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT acquisition_channel, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY acquisition_channel ORDER BY customer_count DESC

cases.utterance: how many stores are in each state?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS store_count FROM stores GROUP BY state ORDER BY store_count DESC

cases.utterance: what is the total revenue by customer segment?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT segment, SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM fct_daily_sales GROUP BY segment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

cases.utterance: what is the revenue per order for each customer segment?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT segment, AVG(total_revenue / total_orders) AS avg_order_value FROM fct_daily_sales GROUP BY segment ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

cases.utterance: how many new versus returning customers did we have per segment?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT segment, SUM(new_customers) AS new_customers, SUM(returning_customers) AS returning_customers FROM fct_daily_sales GROUP BY segment ORDER BY segment

cases.utterance: what is the 7-day retention rate for each customer cohort?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT cohort_date, (CAST(retained_d7 AS DOUBLE) / cohort_size) * 100.0 AS retention_rate_d7 FROM fct_cohort_retention ORDER BY cohort_date

cases.utterance: how many customers do we have in each region?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM dim_customer GROUP BY region ORDER BY customer_count DESC

cases.utterance: how do customer segments rank by total active customers (new plus returning)?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT segment, SUM(new_customers + returning_customers) AS total_active_customers FROM fct_daily_sales GROUP BY segment ORDER BY total_active_customers DESC
